summary: CAIR Action issued a full endorsement of Adams for Oakland's District 2 City Council in the general phase, and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. Both groups assess candidates on Gaza/ceasefire positions, civil rights, and war-lobby funding. His platform covers housing, homelessness, sanctuary-city policy, and local accountability. The endorsement-level CAIR support and Vote for Peace Ally rating, from organizations weighing Palestine-related foreign-policy positions, form the recorded basis for his standing.
